capabilities: Sync chats from Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, AI Studio, Lumo and Hermes
Save files, images and artifacts alongside transcripts
Import local Claude Code and Codex sessions
Snapshot AI memory with a privacy filter
disambiguation: Not an in-vault AI chat client; it imports and syncs existing provider chats as Markdown notes.
extras: Unofficial and read-only; web syncing requires a computer, and the privacy filter can miss unusual secrets.
motivation: To bring AI chats into an Obsidian second brain in the spirit of Karpathy's LLM wiki.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to archive and keep AI conversations from external providers in sync as local Markdown notes.

relations.evidence: ChatGPT | Chats per project, pinned chats included
Google AI Studio | Chats and prompts
Proton Lumo | Chats and projects, decrypted on your computer
Hermes Agent | Chats on this computer, per Hermes profile, with every tool step
Claude Code (desktop app and CLI) | Sessions on this computer
Codex (ChatGPT desktop app and CLI) | Threads on this computer, per project
Its AI group runs AI ChatBridge's sync commands with one click

requires.name: Claude Code or Codex desktop app/CLI

summary: Importer and syncer that mirrors AI chats, files, artifacts and memory snapshots from Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini and others into Markdown notes.
